name: SUPER HOMO!!! Magical Girlfriends
source:
Play as Pumpkin, a magical witch warrior and girl skateboarder as she prepares to defeat the evil Candy Cane with the help of her girlfriend Spice.

[From [url=https://banh-mi.itch.io/super-homo-magical-girlfriends]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
扮演身兼魔法魔女战士与滑板少女双重身份的“小南瓜”，在女友“香辛”的协助下整装待发，一举击败邪恶的“拐杖糖”吧。
